environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023, t3.medium) behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No WAF attached to ALB. Flask app runs as systemd service with gunicorn, SQLite database on local EBS volume. ALB access logs enabled but no real-time alerting configured.
